headline: Reliance Consumer Products Expands Independence Brand With Biscuit Lineup
summary: Reliance Consumer Products Ltd is rolling out an expanded range of Independence biscuits across nine variants, initiating trial packs in Tamil Nadu.
why: Reliance Retail is India's largest retail operator; expanding its private-label FMCG portfolio intensifies competition against domestic packaged foods incumbents.

impacts.name: Reliance Industries Limited
impacts.why: Product portfolio expansion strengthens Reliance's consumer goods presence in regional Indian markets.
